column1: # Country -> region, for the per-run panel's column grouping. AUTHORED.
# FIVE regions. Countries are far too fine a grain for a 7-inch grid (41 of them, most too
# narrow to name) and the finer regional cuts tried before this one -- twelve, then nine --
# still split one clear contrast across several thin blocks. At this grain each block is wide
# enough to read and the comparison the figure is for, Europe against everywhere else, is a
# comparison between two blocks rather than across six.
# FOUR regions. Australia and New Zealand fold into Asia: 27 runs between them made a
# sliver too narrow to read, and the figure's comparison is Europe against the rest rather
# than a geography lesson. The name is wrong for them and the caption says so. Turkey and
# Israel sit in Asia, Morocco in Africa.
# The panel orders regions west to east by the mean longitude of their own runs, so no order
# column is needed here. A country with no runs costs nothing. A country in the data and NOT
# here is a hard error, never a silent "Other".
